en.title: MulDet3D
en.description: Multi-Objective Optimization Based Unsupervised Object Detection for Multiple Roadside LiDARs
en.body:
Status: Accepted at Journal of Transportation Engineering Part A: Systems

Roadside LiDAR systems offer a promising infrastructure-based approach for traffic monitoring, but detecting objects across multiple sensors with varying fields of view remains challenging — especially without labeled training data.

MulDet3D proposes an unsupervised object detection framework that jointly optimizes detection accuracy and computational efficiency across multiple roadside LiDARs. Key contributions include:

  • A multi-objective optimization formulation that balances detection performance across overlapping and non-overlapping sensor zones
  • An unsupervised pipeline that eliminates the need for manually annotated 3D bounding boxes
  • Robust handling of sparse point clouds typical in roadside (infrastructure-side) deployments

This work addresses a critical gap in infrastructure-based sensing for intelligent transportation systems, enabling scalable deployment without costly labeling efforts.

zh.title: MulDet3D
zh.description: 基于多目标优化的多路侧激光雷达无监督目标检测
zh.body:
状态： 已被 Journal of Transportation Engineering Part A: Systems 接收

路侧激光雷达为交通监测提供了基于基础设施的感知方式，但在多个视场不同的传感器之间进行目标检测仍面临挑战，尤其是在缺少标注训练数据时。

MulDet3D 提出无监督目标检测框架，联合优化多个路侧激光雷达的检测精度与计算效率：

  • 通过多目标优化，平衡传感器重叠区域与非重叠区域的检测表现
  • 无需人工标注三维边界框，减少部署中的数据标注成本
  • 针对路侧场景中的稀疏点云进行稳健处理

该研究支持智能交通系统中可扩展的基础设施感知部署。

en.title: FRGB3D
en.description: Fast Reliability-Weighted Gaussian Background Modeling for Roadside LiDAR Traffic Monitoring
en.body:
Status: Accepted at Journal of Computing in Civil Engineering (ASCE JCCE)

Background subtraction is a fundamental step in LiDAR-based traffic monitoring. However, existing methods struggle with environmental noise, sensor drift, and the sparse, non-uniform nature of roadside point clouds.

FRGB3D introduces a fast, reliability-weighted Gaussian mixture model tailored for roadside LiDAR point clouds. Key contributions include:

  • A reliability weighting scheme that accounts for varying point density and sensor noise across the field of view
  • A computationally efficient background modeling pipeline suitable for real-time traffic monitoring
  • Demonstrated robustness under adverse weather and varying traffic conditions

The method provides a strong foundation for downstream tasks such as vehicle detection, tracking, and speed estimation in infrastructure-based sensing systems.

zh.title: FRGB3D
zh.description: 面向路侧激光雷达交通监测的快速可靠性加权高斯背景建模
zh.body:
状态： 已被 Journal of Computing in Civil Engineering（ASCE JCCE） 接收

背景消除是激光雷达交通监测的基础环节。环境噪声、传感器漂移以及路侧点云的稀疏性和不均匀性，都会影响背景建模效果。

FRGB3D 提出适用于路侧激光雷达点云的快速可靠性加权高斯混合模型：

  • 通过可靠性权重考虑视场内点密度与传感器噪声的差异
  • 以高效背景建模流程支持实时交通监测
  • 在恶劣天气与不同交通条件下保持稳健性

该方法为车辆检测、跟踪与速度估计等下游任务提供基础。

en.title: MulTrack3D
en.description: Reliability-Enhanced Self-Correcting Multi-Point Tracking for Multiple Roadside LiDARs
en.body:
Status: Under Review at Journal of Transportation Engineering Part A: Systems

Accurate multi-object tracking across multiple roadside LiDAR sensors is essential for intersection management, traffic flow analysis, and safety assessment. Sensor handoff errors and occlusions make this particularly challenging in real-world deployments.

MulTrack3D proposes a reliability-enhanced tracking framework that self-corrects tracking errors across multiple LiDAR sensors. Key contributions include:

  • A reliability-aware data association mechanism that weights detections by sensor confidence
  • A self-correction module that leverages cross-sensor consistency to recover from tracking failures
  • Seamless multi-LiDAR handoff for continuous vehicle trajectory estimation

This framework is designed for practical deployment on roadside infrastructure, supporting applications from traffic signal control to autonomous vehicle situational awareness.

zh.title: MulTrack3D
zh.description: 面向多路侧激光雷达的可靠性增强自校正多点跟踪
zh.body:
状态： Journal of Transportation Engineering Part A: Systems 审稿中

跨多个路侧激光雷达的准确多目标跟踪，是交叉口管理、交通流分析与安全评估的基础。实际部署中的传感器交接误差与遮挡增加了这一任务的难度。

MulTrack3D 提出可靠性增强跟踪框架，以自校正方式处理跨传感器跟踪误差：

  • 依据传感器置信度对检测结果加权，实现可靠性感知的数据关联
  • 利用跨传感器一致性，从跟踪失败中恢复
  • 支持多激光雷达之间的连续交接与车辆轨迹估计

框架面向实际路侧部署，可服务于交通信号控制和自动驾驶态势感知等应用。

en.title: Roadway Asset Management Optimization
en.description: Multi-objective optimization for integrated roadway asset maintenance and rehabilitation considering traffic dynamics and environmental impacts
en.body:
Status: Accepted at Transportation Research Record (TRR)

Roadway asset management involves complex trade-offs between agency costs, user costs, environmental impacts, and network-level performance. Traditional single-objective approaches fail to capture this complexity.

This project develops a multi-objective optimization framework for integrated roadway asset maintenance and rehabilitation (M&R) planning that explicitly accounts for:

  • Traffic dynamics: M&R activities cause lane closures and detours, generating user delay costs that vary by timing and location
  • Environmental impacts: Construction activities and vehicle emissions during work zones are incorporated as optimization objectives
  • Network-level coordination: Segment-level decisions are jointly optimized to maximize network performance

Related publications:

  • Meng et al. (2023). Multiobjective optimization method for pavement segment grouping. Journal of Infrastructure Systems, 29(1), 04022047.

The framework enables transportation agencies to make informed, data-driven investment decisions that balance budget constraints against service quality and sustainability goals.

zh.title: 道路资产管理优化
zh.description: 考虑交通动态与环境影响的道路资产综合养护多目标优化
zh.body:
状态： 已被 Transportation Research Record（TRR） 接收

道路资产管理需要在管理部门成本、用户成本、环境影响和路网表现之间进行权衡，单目标方法难以充分表达这些需求。

本项目构建用于道路资产综合养护规划的多目标优化框架，重点考虑：

  • 交通动态： 养护导致的车道封闭与绕行，以及随时间和位置变化的用户延误成本
  • 环境影响： 将施工活动及施工区域车辆排放纳入优化目标
  • 路网协调： 联合优化路段决策，提升路网整体表现

框架为交通管理部门提供数据驱动的投资决策支持，平衡预算、服务质量与可持续发展目标。

相关论文与成果：

  • Meng et al. (2023). Multiobjective optimization method for pavement segment grouping. Journal of Infrastructure Systems, 29(1), 04022047.

en.title: Pavement Maintenance Planning under Uncertainty
en.description: Network-level pavement maintenance and rehabilitation planning using chance-constrained programming
en.body:
Status: Published

Real-world pavement management is subject to significant uncertainties — in pavement deterioration rates, material costs, traffic growth, and budget availability. Deterministic optimization models cannot adequately address these risks.

This project introduces a chance-constrained programming approach to network-level pavement M&R planning, ensuring that budget and performance constraints are satisfied with a specified probability even under uncertain conditions.

Key contributions include:

  • Formulation of pavement M&R planning as a stochastic optimization problem with probabilistic constraints
  • A tractable solution methodology that converts chance constraints into deterministic equivalents
  • Case studies demonstrating improved reliability of long-term maintenance plans compared to deterministic approaches

Related publications:

  • Cao, R., Meng, S., et al. (2024). Network-level pavement maintenance and rehabilitation planning considering uncertainties using chance-constrained programming. International Journal of Pavement Engineering, 25(1), 2340001.
  • Hu, A., Bai, Q., Chen, L., Meng, S., et al. (2022). A review on empirical methods of pavement performance modeling. Construction and Building Materials, 342, 127968.

zh.title: 不确定性下的路面养护规划
zh.description: 基于机会约束规划的路网级路面养护决策
zh.body:
状态： 已发表

路面性能衰变、材料成本、交通增长和可用预算均存在不确定性，确定性模型难以充分处理这些风险。

本项目采用机会约束规划方法，使路网级养护方案即使在不确定条件下，也能以给定概率满足预算与性能约束：

  • 将养护规划表述为包含概率约束的随机优化问题
  • 将机会约束转化为可求解的确定性等价形式
  • 通过案例研究，展示相较于确定性方法的长期养护规划可靠性提升

相关论文与成果：

  • Cao, R., Meng, S., et al. (2024). Network-level pavement maintenance and rehabilitation planning considering uncertainties using chance-constrained programming. International Journal of Pavement Engineering, 25(1), 2340001.
  • Hu, A., Bai, Q., Chen, L., Meng, S., et al. (2022). A review on empirical methods of pavement performance modeling. Construction and Building Materials, 342, 127968.

en.title: Airport Curbside Vehicle Detection
en.description: Deep learning-based detection of illegal pick-up vehicles at airport departure levels
en.body:
Status: Published + Granted Patent

Illegal pick-up and drop-off activities at airport curbside zones create traffic congestion and safety hazards. Manual enforcement is costly and inconsistent, motivating an automated vision-based detection system.

This project developed an end-to-end deep learning pipeline for detecting and classifying illegal curbside vehicles from surveillance cameras at airport departure levels.

Key contributions include:

  • A video-based vehicle detection and behavior recognition system tailored for airport curbside environments
  • Handling of occlusion, varying lighting, and high vehicle density typical in airport settings
  • Deployment as a functional monitoring system (Software Copyright registered)

Related publications and IP:

  • Bai, Q., Shao, Y., Meng, S., et al. (2022). Video-based detection method for illegal pick-up vehicles at airport departure levels. Journal of Chang’an University (Natural Science Edition), 42(04), 73–86.
  • Wu, S., Meng, S., et al. (2025). Automatic detection method for illegal vehicles at airport departure levels based on deep learning. [Granted Patent 202111642183.3]
  • Meng, S. (2023). Airport curbside illegal vehicle monitoring system. [Software Copyright]

zh.title: 机场路侧车辆检测
zh.description: 基于深度学习的机场出发层违规接客车辆检测
zh.body:
状态： 论文已发表，专利已授权

机场路侧区域的违规接送客行为会带来拥堵与安全隐患，而人工执法成本较高、标准难以保持一致。

本项目构建端到端的深度学习流程，利用机场出发层监控视频检测与识别违规车辆：

  • 面向机场路侧场景开展车辆检测与行为识别
  • 处理遮挡、光照变化和高车辆密度等复杂情况
  • 开发可运行的监测系统，并登记软件著作权

相关论文与成果：

  • Bai, Q., Shao, Y., Meng, S., et al. (2022). Video-based detection method for illegal pick-up vehicles at airport departure levels. Journal of Chang’an University (Natural Science Edition), 42(04), 73–86.
  • Wu, S., Meng, S., et al. (2025). Automatic detection method for illegal vehicles at airport departure levels based on deep learning. [Granted Patent 202111642183.3]
  • Meng, S. (2023). Airport curbside illegal vehicle monitoring system. [Software Copyright]

en.title: Personalized VISTA
en.description: Vision-Language Safety Assistant for Trustworthy Autonomy
en.body:
Status: In Preparation — Target: NeurIPS

As autonomous vehicles become increasingly capable, ensuring trustworthy and explainable decision-making in safety-critical scenarios remains an open challenge. Vision-language models (VLMs) offer a promising path toward human-aligned autonomy.

Personalized VISTA develops a vision-language safety assistant framework that provides personalized, context-aware safety guidance for autonomous systems.

Key aspects of this work include:

  • Integration of large vision-language models for scene understanding and risk assessment in driving contexts
  • A personalization mechanism that adapts safety recommendations to user preferences and driving styles
  • A trustworthiness framework that balances autonomy with human oversight in safety-critical situations

This project represents an intersection of my work in intelligent transportation systems and emerging foundation model capabilities, targeting trustworthy deployment of autonomous vehicles in complex real-world environments.

zh.title: Personalized VISTA
zh.description: 面向可信自主系统的视觉语言安全助手
zh.body:
状态： 研究准备中，目标投稿会议为 NeurIPS

随着自动驾驶能力提升，安全关键场景中的可信、可解释决策仍是重要挑战。视觉语言模型为与人类需求一致的自主系统提供了新的研究方向。

Personalized VISTA 致力于构建视觉语言安全助手，为自主系统提供个性化、结合情境的安全指导：

  • 利用大型视觉语言模型理解驾驶场景并评估风险
  • 根据用户偏好与驾驶风格调整安全建议
  • 在安全关键场景中，平衡自主性与人工监督

项目连接智能交通研究与基础模型能力，探索复杂真实环境中的可信自动驾驶部署。
